checks.claim: Main analysis compares each new case to the identical seed/tolerance Mao baseline and writes branch differences in both tolerance levels.

Energy integrands use signed source power/(nb H eV) on actual dense1025 states; expansion work is negative work/eV. Candidate bath difference is split into energy-density replacement and Planck recoil/induced reference correction.
Resolution flags compare refined branch differences to the sum of observed same-branch refinement maxima; stress-only and shear-inclusive quantities remain distinct.
Collision adapter checks loaded module paths, immutable provider hashes, saved ne=nb(q dot Y), eta=(1+q) dot Y, isotope scales, temperatures and nested dense grids.
H/He CI transitions preserve isotope inventories; CI kinetic loss and binding gain cancel in total gas energy, while one new electron contributes the separate -particle/(H eta) temperature forcing.
CE_HI targets native indices1,3,5 and CE_HeII indices8,11; powers use nb ne Y times source SI coefficient and optically thin escape signs. Unsupported Li/HeI CE entries remain unavailable.
Both coefficient support and continuation/underflow masks remain separate. Trapezoid partitions use intervals whose two retained endpoints lie in source support; Simpson is stored separately.
Actual eight-case analyzed numbers, support fractions, figures and conclusions agree with saved output arrays.
checks.next_action: Independently recompute results from completed saved arrays and inspect the rendered figures.

limits: Fixture evidence is input-contract evidence only; it is not a scientific trajectory or collision budget.
Collision coefficients are evaluated with explicit analytic continuation where the published fit domain does not apply.
CI/CE are diagnostic omitted sources on the new Compton paths; they are not terms dynamically applied in those IVPs.
No proof of continuum positivity, full radiation closure, global convergence or production validity is inferred.
